verdict.rationale: Conductor's core interaction is natural-language chat with coding agents. The agent can configure the cloud computer itself (test repos, edit setup scripts, run builds) [conductor-docs-32][conductor-docs-17]. A hosted MCP server lets ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP clients manage cloud workspaces conversationally [conductor-docs-14][conductor-probe-4], and the API accepts prompts to agents [conductor-docs-30]. Missing for 10: native in-app natural-language control of Conductor's own features (creating workspaces, settings, and reassignment are documented as UI and keyboard actions), NL workspace management that goes beyond cloud workspaces and doesn't require an external MCP client, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP-driven management.
